_comment: The toolset that DESCRIBES bootstrap, kept outside it so bootstrap does not have one. Re-created 2026-09-29 (bean xsqm) on the terms bean etg1 first set, after bean 319n had folded it into cat-harness: across two repositories, Zod in cat-harness would make a bootstrap release depend on cat-harness, which depends on bootstrap. A SIBLING, never nested in bootstrap, because nesting would put .ts inside the tree a Bootstrapping Agent is told holds none. It depends on bootstrap and on nothing above it — `check:tools-closure` fails on any import that leaves it. It is ONE toolset over swappable content: someone who wants a different visualiser or generator uses a different toolset against the same bootstrap.

_needs_comment: The one layer below it. It reads and writes bootstrap; bootstrap never imports from here.
_supports_comment: Which content versions these tools handle, as a list of supported MAJOR versions per content graph — never a range expression (instance-versioning rule 2). Within one major a newer minor or patch only adds. At the split both started at the same version (0.1.0); from here each is versioned on its own, and a tools release may support several content majors (owner, 2026-09-29). A tool refuses a content major not listed here rather than guessing.
